verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents testing with isolated per-test namespaces and offers copy-on-write namespace branching, which lets users test against a clone of real data without modifying the production namespace. This is namespace-level isolation inside the same account, not a dedicated sandbox environment. missing for 10: a documented separate sandbox/test environment or account tier, docs detailing isolation guarantees (e.g. separate credentials or scoped tokens for test vs production), hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Branch from namespace: instantly creates a copy-on-write clone of a namespace.
Paginate through the list of namespaces, optionally with a given prefix.
